recommended_steps.detail: Judge whether the refusal texts and the documented section shape are clear enough to hand to an operator.
recommended_steps.title: Run the User Demo and read docs/bedrock.md

recommended_steps.detail: One build and one search against the real model in one in-Region location (us-east-1, eu-west-1 or ap-northeast-1 today), from a workstation profile and from an instance role, with the Region's retention mode set to none and the IAM grants bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:GetAccountDataRetention in place. The repository's proofs are hermetic and do not establish this.
recommended_steps.title: Live AWS qualification is a separate, paid, operator-approved action

recommended_steps.detail: Build concurrency ceiling 4 and the 120,000-unit request budget are engineering defaults; the model allowlist is exactly cohere.embed-v4:0; whether a production bearer-credential environment variable should be refused is an open owner question.
recommended_steps.title: Settle the unmeasured defaults

recommended_steps.detail: uv tool install --editable . --reinstall, because Conric is a new dependency.
recommended_steps.title: Reinstall the editable system-wide tool

see_for_yourself.expected: The first run prints Configured embedding; no inference request was made. and the stamped identity reads provider=bedrock:us-east-1 dim=1536; each variation is refused with the field path, the allowed values or the missing field, and the file and line Conric attributes. No credential is read and nothing leaves the machine.
steps: Write defaults.yaml: palace → embedding with provider bedrock, model cohere.embed-v4:0, region us-east-1; and site.yaml: palace → embedding → dim 1536.
./bin/python -m palace.cli providers set --operation embedding --store .demo-bedrock --settings defaults.yaml --settings site.yaml
Change dim to 1000 in site.yaml and rerun providers set; then restore it, remove region from defaults.yaml and rerun; then add an unknown key under palace and rerun.
see_for_yourself.title: Compose a Bedrock selection without any network

what_just_landed.detail: Cohere Embed v4 by direct regional model id on the Bedrock runtime, authenticated only through the AWS SDK credential chain, with a fail-closed same-Region data-retention check that requires the mode none before any embedding request, document and query input types, batches of at most 96 inside a conservative request budget, bounded retries with SDK retries off, and an audit record for every attempt. Ambient SDK endpoint overrides are ignored so every request lands in the selector's Region.
what_just_landed.title: A registered Bedrock embedding provider

what_just_landed.detail: A consumer hands Palace its composed configuration files and root; Palace validates its own top-level palace section through the same validator as the TOML selector and initializes a store's selector once, refusing a different existing selector. palace providers set --settings is the command-line entry point.
what_just_landed.title: Composed Palace settings

what_just_landed.detail: The vector table is declared at the store's selected dimension and readers compare against the declared width, so narrower models fit without padding; a table created at another width is refused with a rebuild remedy, including before any provider request.
what_just_landed.title: Per-store vector width

what_just_landed.detail: Three new proof families funded by compensating retirements keep the estate at zero growth; every Bedrock test drives real SDK clients through stubs under a session guard that isolates credentials and refuses any real send. Conric is pinned by commit; release and CI install it separately from the hash-locked requirements.
what_just_landed.title: Offline proofs and a Git-pinned dependency
